data-text: Uploaded demos and reports are stored by your configured analysis server. This version is a local workspace without account isolation; public hosting requires a separate access and retention design.
facts-text: Parsed players, roster-based teams, rounds, K/D/A and recorded events. Additional match metrics appear when the analysis service provides them. Teams stay together when T and CT sides switch.
faq-metrics: How should I read the metrics?
future-text: Contextual ratings, team coordination and tactical conclusions need additional analysis. They remain unavailable until the service calculates them.
intro: A scoreboard describes what happened. Understanding why takes context. We keep those two things separate.
title: Evidence over assumptions.
uncertainty-text: A dash means unavailable, not zero. Partial matches show their quality issues. An ordinary death is never presented as a proven mistake.
